source.title: Application period closed for Continental Championships 2020
source.content:
Application submissions are now closed for Continental Championships 2020. Thank you to all who submitted their offers! The cities listed were submitted and will be selected by the Board of Directors.
 <!-- break --> 
**Asian Championship:**
Hangzhou, China
Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Seoul, Republic of Korea
 
**European Championship:**
Almere, Netherlands
 
**North American Championship:**
Toronto, Canada
 
**Oceanian Championship:**
Auckland, New Zealand
 
There were no applications received for Africa or South America.
 
The candidacy documents will be made public after the decisions are finalized. The final list of the competition locations will be announced by the end of August, so stay tuned for the decisions!

translation.title: 2020 年各洲锦标赛申办已截止
translation.content:
2020 年各洲锦标赛的申办材料提交现已截止。感谢所有提交申办方案的团队！以下城市提出了申请，董事会将从中选出举办地。

**亚洲锦标赛：**

- 中国杭州
- 哈萨克斯坦努尔苏丹
- 马来西亚吉隆坡
- 韩国首尔

**欧洲锦标赛：**

- 荷兰阿尔梅勒

**北美洲锦标赛：**

- 加拿大多伦多

**大洋洲锦标赛：**

- 新西兰奥克兰

非洲和南美洲锦标赛没有收到申请。

申办材料将在决定确定后公开。最终举办地名单将在 8 月底前公布，敬请关注！
